exam.title: Vault Associate (003)
exam.study_prerequisites: Basic terminal, on-premises or cloud architecture, and security knowledge; hands-on Vault practice in a disposable environment is strongly recommended.

review.notes: All nine unweighted domains and their published subobjectives are mapped to an identity-to-secret lifecycle, decision tables, failure modes, six independent labs, original checks, and primary HashiCorp sources. The guide preserves the official Vault 1.16 exam baseline while marking current releases, HCP service responsibilities, editions, limits, and interfaces as volatile.

findings.title: Union shorthand omitted path priority
findings.evidence: Identical path patterns merge; differing matching patterns use priority and lists are not filtered by per-key permission.
findings.recommendation: Teach matching order/list disclosure and nonroot verification.

findings.title: Environment-variable objective lacked instruction

findings.title: KV lifecycle needed a usable recovery model
findings.evidence: Soft deletion, version destruction and metadata deletion have different recovery implications.
findings.recommendation: Add lifecycle/CAS example and distinguish deleting a copy from revoking a credential.
